Checking out someone else can be seen as a breach of that trust, signaling disrespect or dissatisfaction with your current relationship. 2. **Dishonesty**: If your wife were to find out, it could create emotional pain and damage the foundation of your relationship. That said, **context matters**. If you’re struggling with feelings or dissatisfaction, addressing them openly and constructively with your wife (rather than acting on them) is far healthier than passive observation.
